framed.name: Halcyon
framed.sub: Shaker with subtle detailing · Flex construction

handles.name: Knurl Bar
handles.desc: Round bar with crisp diamond knurling: the modern classic for shaker and slab doors.

handles.name: Knurl Bar with Backplate
handles.desc: The Knurl Bar on a slim matching backplate that frames the handle and protects painted doors.

handles.name: Knurl T-Bar
handles.desc: Single-fixing T-bar knob to pair with the Knurl Bar on small doors and drawers.
handles.note: 57 mm long · 33 mm projection · single fixing

handles.name: Knurl Tall Pull
handles.desc: Heavy-gauge knurled pull for larders, tall housings and wardrobes. With or without backplate.

handles.name: Knurl Rail
handles.desc: Knurled rail on stand-off posts with round feet. The 760 mm length suits appliance and larder doors.

handles.name: Reeded Rail
handles.desc: Finely ribbed rail on stand-off posts: a tailored detail for traditional and contemporary schemes.

handles.name: Fluted Bar
handles.desc: Deeply fluted bar with a soft, classical profile.

handles.name: Hex Bar
handles.desc: Faceted hexagonal bar that catches the light on every edge.

handles.name: Hex Bar with Backplate
handles.desc: The Hex Bar mounted on a matching backplate.

handles.name: Hex T-Bar
handles.note: 50 mm long · 35 mm projection · single fixing

handles.name: Square Pull
handles.desc: Crisp square-section pull: architectural and minimal.

handles.name: Square T-Bar
handles.desc: Square-section T-bar knob to pair with the Square Pull.
handles.note: 60 mm long · 31 mm projection · single fixing

handles.name: Taper Pull
handles.desc: Edge-style pull with tapered feet. The 60 mm size works as a knob.

handles.name: Oval Bar
handles.desc: Soft oval-section bar with a comfortable grip.

handles.name: Deco Pull
handles.desc: Flat, rounded-end pull with a strong Art Deco silhouette.

handles.name: Colour Bar
handles.desc: Powder-coated round bar in five statement colours.

handles.name: Colour T-Bar
handles.desc: Single-fixing T-bar knob in matching powder-coated colours.
handles.note: 57 mm long · 35 mm projection · single fixing

handles.name: Crescent Pull
handles.desc: Crescent-shaped edge pull that sits on the top edge of the door or drawer: no handle line, just colour.
handles.note: 80 × 40 mm · fits the top edge of the door or drawer
